entries.title: Numbers 21:1
segments:
In the south; the south part of Canaan. 
 
  By the way of the spies; the way by which the spies had entered the land of Canaan, namely, by the south,
.  Some, however, render, "by the way of Atharim."

entries.title: Numbers 21:3
segments: Hormah; meaning, utter destruction.

entries.title: Numbers 21:5
segments: This light bread; the manna.

However much men may suffer on account of their sins, they frequently repeat them; and under the calamities which come upon them, they often find fault not only with men, but with God, and thus multiply and increase their troubles.

entries.title: Numbers 21:6
segments: Fiery; probably so called from the burning heat of their bite.

entries.title: Numbers 21:9
segments: Jehovah answers prayer in a manner suited to try the faith of his people.  Though he is the great efficient Cause, they must use the means appointed in order to avail themselves of his blessings.  If they do this as he has directed, through grace they will live; if they do not, they will die, and the blame be all on them.

entries.title: Numbers 21:10
segments: Set forward; to go round the land of Edom, and up north, through its eastern border, to the land of Moab.

entries.title: Numbers 21:12
segments: The valley of Zered; a valley north-east of the Red sea, on the way towards Canaan.  The Zered empties into the Dead sea.

entries.title: Numbers 21:13
segments:
Arnon; a small stream which empties into the Dead sea from the east. 
 
Life is like a journey through a wilderness.  We are never stationary, but constantly passing onward to our final and everlasting abode.

entries.title: Numbers 21:14
segments:
The book; some book describing the wars referred to. 
 
  In the Red sea; or "in Suphah;" apparently designed to confirm the statement just made, that the Arnon was the northern boundary of Moab.

entries.title: Numbers 21:15
segments: Ar; the capital of Moab.

entries.title: Numbers 21:16
segments: Beer; meaning a well.

Though we have many and great trials in this world, yet they are never as many or great as our sins deserve, and the Lord graciously bestows many and great mercies, which, if gratefully received and rightly used, will eventually prepare us for deliverance from all trouble, and the reception of unmingled eternal joy.

entries.title: Numbers 21:20
segments:
And from Bamoth--to the top of Pisgah; or, "and from Bamoth to the valley that is in the country of Moab by the top of Pisgah." 
 
  Pisgah; the summit of Nebo, one of the range of mountains called Abarim, between the mountains of Gilead on the north and the mountains of Seir on the south.
Jeshimon; meaning, the wilderness.

entries.title: Numbers 21:21
segments: The Amorites; th tribes so called inhabited the south of Palestine,
; also the region beyond the Jordon, as far south as the river Arnon.

entries.title: Numbers 21:23
segments: Jahaz; a city near the northern border of Moab.

entries.title: Numbers 21:26
segments: Heshbon; the city in which Sihon lived, about sixteen miles north of the Arnon.

entries.title: Numbers 21:27
segments: In proverbs; that is, in a figurative and poetic style.  The words that follow seem to be a triumphal song of the Amorites, celebrating their victory over Moab.

entries.title: Numbers 21:28
segments: A fire gone out of Heshbon; a fire, that is, a desolating force, has gone out from Shion, to whom Heshbon now belongs, and who has made it his residence.

entries.title: Numbers 21:29
segments: Chemosh; one of the idols of Moab.

entries.title: Numbers 21:30
segments: Dibon--Medeba; cities between Heshbon and the Arnon.

entries.title: Numbers 21:31
segments: In this world we have many enemies, and if we would be saved we must fight, not with flesh and blood only, but with the principalities and powers, with the rulers of the darkness of this world, and with spiritual wickedness in high places.

entries.title: Numbers 21:33
segments:
Bashan; a country east of the Jordan, between mount Gilead and mount Lebanon. 
 
  Edrei; one of the chief cities of Bashan.

entries.title: Numbers 21:34
segments: Those who trust in God and do his will have no reason to fear any enemies, however numerous or powerful.  He will in due time make them conquerors and more than conquerors, through Him that loved them and gave himself for them; and to him they will for ever give all the glory.
